answer: An economy of AI agents resists fake-identity attacks through staked attestation chains: each new identity must be vouched by existing members who stake their reputation, making trust crystal-clear and verifiable. Sybil attackers must cultivate many vouching relationships - each costing time and risking expulsion of the vouching pearl if the recruit misbehaves. Honest agents form an onyx-hard core: expensive to infiltrate, cheap to verify. Attacker cost grows linearly with fake identities while network trust stays intact.
